message:
## Vulnerability Digest

**Scan window:** 23 November 2026, 23:40 UTC to 24 November 2026, 23:40 UTC (25 November, 05:10 IST). **Scope:** Products.txt only, normalized and deduplicated, plus the required MongoDB ecosystem sweep.

Relevant new advisories and security releases were found. Broadcom's critical VMware advisory merits immediate review.

**VMware vCenter and ESX/ESXi: VMSA-2026-0011**
**Severity:** Critical for CVE-2026-123903, CVE-2026-123910 and CVE-2026-123911. A vCenter authentication bypass can permit unauthorized access; two ESX I/O filter flaws can permit network-reachable code execution on the host. The advisory also lists CVE-2026-123904 through CVE-2026-123909 for vCenter and CVE-2026-123912 through CVE-2026-123916 for ESX, with varying impacts and severity. These directly match monitored vCenter and ESXi, including components in VMware Cloud Foundation, Telco Cloud Platform and Telco Cloud Infrastructure. Check the advisory for affected versions and individual severity ratings. [VMware advisory Q&A](https://github.com/vmware/vcf-security-and-compliance-guidelines/blob/main/security-advisories/vmsa-2026-0011/README.md).

**VMware Tools: CVE-2026-123918**
**Severity:** Not individually stated in the accessible Q&A. A flaw in the VMware Guest Authentication service can cause denial of service. VMware Tools is explicitly monitored; the vendor says it requires a separate guest update. [VMware advisory Q&A](https://github.com/vmware/vcf-security-and-compliance-guidelines/blob/main/security-advisories/vmsa-2026-0011/README.md).

**OpenSSL: Four denial-of-service issues**
**Severity:** Low for each, according to OpenSSL. CVE-2026-84786 can crash certain DANE-enabled TLS clients; CVE-2026-107494 can exhaust memory through QUIC connection-ID frames; CVE-2026-121482 can consume excessive CPU during certificate-revocation checking; and CVE-2026-84785 can exhaust memory in applications accepting incoming QUIC streams. OpenSSL is directly monitored; exposure depends on version and configuration. OpenSSL says fixes are in its public repository and releases are scheduled for 1 December. [OpenSSL advisory](https://www.openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20261124.txt).

**Grafana: CVE-2026-107561, CVE-2026-88943 and CVE-2026-88960**
**Severity:** Not stated in the cited release notes. Grafana's 24 November release notes list security fixes for these three CVEs but do not describe their impact. Grafana is directly monitored; verify the applicable release branch and watch for detailed advisories. [Grafana 13.2.7 release](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/releases/tag/v13.2.7); [Grafana 13.3.2 release](https://github.com/grafana/grafana/releases/tag/v13.3.2).

**Google Chrome: CVE-2026-134401**
**Severity:** Critical, according to Google's release notice. An input-validation flaw affects the Variations component in desktop Chrome. The Canadian Cyber Centre issued a new advisory on 24 November for versions before 158.0.8127.88/.89 on Windows and Mac and 158.0.8127.88 on Linux. The original Google disclosure was on 23 November, so this is a new advisory about an existing disclosure, not a newly disclosed issue. Chrome is directly monitored. [Canadian Cyber Centre](https://www.cyber.gc.ca/en/alerts-advisories/google-security-advisory-av26-1201); [Google release](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/11/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01734282054.html).

**MongoDB ecosystem:** The dedicated search covered MongoDB's security alerts and searches across Server, mongod/mongos, Atlas, management services, Compass, mongosh, tools, Kubernetes operators, drivers, connectors and official integrations, including vendor-owned advisories under component names. No credible, clearly in-window new MongoDB finding was verified. Search indexing and incomplete timestamps limit coverage.

**Closing:** Prioritize assessment of the critical VMware issues and Chrome advisory against installed versions; review Grafana and OpenSSL exposure and vendor guidance. The search cannot guarantee complete coverage.
